text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"CA","level":"state","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"California FEHA limits on source-of-income and criminal-history screening of rental applicants","requirement":"Housing providers may not refuse to rent based on source of income, including Housing Choice (Section 8) vouchers, other rental assistance, SSI, or wages. They may not refuse to complete required rental-assistance paperwork or advertise \"No Section 8\". Housing providers may check an applicant's criminal history, but may not consider arrests that did not lead to a conviction, sealed or expunged records, or juvenile justice records. Blanket bans on all applicants with a criminal history are prohibited. A denial based on a conviction must be directly related to the applicant's ability to be a good tenant and to not threaten the health and safety of others or the property.
